title: Manage disk partitions interactively
summary: Use the interactive fdisk tool to create, delete, or view partitions on a specific drive. Changes are only saved when you explicitly write them.

steps.explain: Start the interactive fdisk session for a specific disk device.

placeholders.name: DEVICE
placeholders.description: The disk device to manage, e.g. /dev/sda

steps.explain: View the current partition table to see what exists.
Create a new partition. You will be prompted for details.
steps.expect: Prompts for partition number, type, and size.

steps.explain: Delete an existing partition. You will be prompted to select which one.
steps.expect: Prompts for the partition number to delete.

steps.explain: Write the changes to the disk. This step is irreversible for deleted data.
steps.expect: fdisk exits and changes are saved.

steps.explain: Quit without saving any changes made in this session.

warnings: Deleting or modifying partitions can result in permanent data loss.
Ensure you have backed up important data before proceeding.
Changes are only applied when you use the 'w' command.

rollback.explain: If you have not yet written changes, quit to discard them.
